Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Iowa Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 55,445,254 megawatthours
B. 15,018,894 megawatthours

Source citation: Iowa Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/iowa/index.php)

Source text:
Iowa Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Iowa)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 23,226 | 19 |
| Electric utilities | 18,498 | 14 |
| IPP & CHP | 4,729 | 28 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 70,464,148 | 21 |
| Electric utilities | 55,445,254 | 18 |
| IPP & CHP | 15,018,894 | 29 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.
